subject: Quantitative Aptitude
topic: Time speed distance III — mixed tiers
description: TSD: average speed, relative speed, conversions, train/platform problems

questions.stem: A car covers 60 km in 1 hour 15 minutes. Its speed in km/h is:
questions.explanation: Time = 1 h 15 min = 5/4 h. Speed = distance/time = 60 / (5/4) = 60 × 4/5 = 48 km/h. Distractor 45 = 60 / 1.33 with rounding error. Distractor 50 = arbitrary. Distractor 52 = arbitrary.
questions.subject: Quant
questions.topic: Time speed distance III — mixed tiers

questions.stem: A man covers half a journey at 40 km/h and the other half at 60 km/h. His AVERAGE speed for the whole journey is:
questions.explanation: When EQUAL DISTANCES are covered at different speeds, average = HARMONIC MEAN = 2ab/(a+b) = 2(40)(60)/(40+60) = 4800/100 = 48 km/h. Distractor 50 = arithmetic mean (a+b)/2 — common trap. Distractor 45/52 = arbitrary. Note: when EQUAL TIMES at different speeds → average = arithmetic mean.
questions.subject: Quant
questions.topic: Time speed distance III — mixed tiers

questions.stem: Two trains 120 m and 180 m long are running in OPPOSITE directions at 50 km/h and 40 km/h. Time taken to cross each other:
questions.explanation: Opposite directions → relative speed = 50 + 40 = 90 km/h = 90 × (5/18) = 25 m/s. Total length to cross = 120 + 180 = 300 m. Time = 300/25 = 12 s. Distractor 10 = used 30 m/s. Distractor 15 = used 20 m/s. Distractor 18 = used relative speed wrongly (10 km/h difference if same direction).
questions.subject: Quant
questions.topic: Time speed distance III — mixed tiers

questions.stem: A train running at 72 km/h crosses a platform 200 m long in 20 seconds. The length of the train is:
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 km/h = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Distance covered in 20 s = 20 × 20 = 400 m. This = train length + platform length = 400 m. Train length = 400 − 200 = 200 m. Distractor 180 = arithmetic slip. Distractor 220 = used 21 m/s. Distractor 240 = used 22 m/s.
questions.subject: Quant
questions.topic: Time speed distance III — mixed tiers

questions.stem: Walking at 4/5 of his usual speed, a man reaches office 15 minutes late. His usual time to reach office is:
questions.explanation: If speed becomes 4/5 of usual, time becomes 5/4 of usual (inverse relation). New time − usual time = 15 min. So (5/4)t − t = 15 → t/4 = 15 → t = 60 min. Distractor 45 = arbitrary. Distractor 55 = forgot full inverse logic. Distractor 75 = added 15 to 60.
questions.subject: Quant
questions.topic: Time speed distance III — mixed tiers

questions.stem: A train 150 m long passes a stationary man in 6 seconds. Its speed is:
questions.explanation: Speed = 150/6 = 25 m/s = 25 × (18/5) = 90 km/h. (m/s × 18/5 = km/h). Distractor 75 = arithmetic slip. Distractor 100 = used 27.78 m/s. Distractor 108 = converted 25 with wrong factor.
questions.subject: Quant
questions.topic: Time speed distance III — mixed tiers

questions.stem: A person rides a bike for 50 km at 25 km/h, then for 70 km at 35 km/h. His average speed for the whole journey is:
questions.explanation: Average speed = total distance / total time. T1 = 50/25 = 2 h. T2 = 70/35 = 2 h. Total distance = 120 km. Total time = 4 h. Average = 120/4 = 30 km/h. (Coincidentally equals AM here because times happen to be equal.) Distractor 32/28 = arbitrary; distractor 31 = wrong.
